quotes.author: Abby Mimms
quotes.text: Captain Dwayne was honestly the best! It was my sisters bachelorette and we booked the boat but it was raining the day that we went. Dwayne made it his mission to still make sure we had the best time ever and the rain didn’t stop us! He took us to some really cool cliff jumping spots , sang our hearts out and stopped for icecream! Hands down the best experience ever. Would definitely do it again if we come back!

quotes.author: Steffanni Hannah
quotes.text: Dwayne was the absolute best! We had a fabulous time on his tour spending the day out on the water. He was so kind and thoughtful with where he took us and showed us around the best areas to swim and rock jump, but also the history of the area. We cannot wait to come back with our families. The karaoke machine was an unexpected hilarious touch and made it so much fun!!

quotes.author: Mariette Haras
quotes.text: Northwestern charters took our family long week end over the top. What an amazing experience through tight beautiful, channels, and taking us to a private swimming area. The captain was knowledgeable about the area, mixing history facts , music and Karaoke fun. Going back with friends soon.

quotes.author: Erica L
quotes.text: Amazing experience! I loved the tour, very clearly knew the area and history well. Insightful and thoughtful, my group had a blast! I highly recommend for anyone visiting the area, locals too!

quotes.author: Marie Murray
quotes.text: We had the opportunity to take a tour of Georgian Vay and 30,000 Islands. Amazing trip. The boat captain was very personably and knowledgeable! A real treat. Thank you

quotes.author: Jessica Pritchard
quotes.text: Thanks to the captain for sharing your knowledge and the amazing tour around the islands! We had a blast and can’t wait to bring more family members for a tour.
